name: SPY-TLT Correlation Flip: Cross-Asset Response
description: When the 60-day rolling correlation between SPY and TLT flips from negative to positive, how do gold (GLD), the US dollar (UUP), and VIX behave over the next 5, 10, and 20 trading days? Shows the rolling correlation with event markers at each flip, median forward returns by asset and horizon, and a summary table with hit rates.
source:
# SPY-TLT Correlation Flip → Cross-Asset Response
# Signal: 60d rolling corr(SPY, TLT) crosses from negative to positive
# Response: GLD, UUP (dollar proxy), VIX forward returns at 5d/10d/20d

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
tlt = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.TLT)()
gld = common_reference_stocks(ticker=ReferenceStock.GLD)()
uup = reference_stocks(ticker='UUP')()
vix = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()

# --- Returns for correlation ---
spy_ret = returns(period=1)(src.c)
tlt_ret = returns(period=1)(ffill(tlt.c))

# --- Rolling correlation & signal ---
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60)(spy_ret, tlt_ret)
is_flip = crossover(corr_60d, 0.0)

# --- Forward returns on response assets (price series — safe for forward_returns) ---
# GLD
gld_close = ffill(gld.c)
gld_fwd_5 = forward_returns(period=5)(gld_close)
gld_fwd_10 = forward_returns(period=10)(gld_close)
gld_fwd_20 = forward_returns(period=20)(gld_close)

# UUP (dollar proxy)
uup_close = ffill(uup.c)
uup_fwd_5 = forward_returns(period=5)(uup_close)
uup_fwd_10 = forward_returns(period=10)(uup_close)
uup_fwd_20 = forward_returns(period=20)(uup_close)

# VIX (index level, always positive — forward_returns is safe)
vix_close = ffill(vix.c)
vix_fwd_5 = forward_returns(period=5)(vix_close)
vix_fwd_10 = forward_returns(period=10)(vix_close)
vix_fwd_20 = forward_returns(period=20)(vix_close)

# --- Filter forward returns to flip events only ---
gld_5 = where(is_flip, gld_fwd_5)
gld_10 = where(is_flip, gld_fwd_10)
gld_20 = where(is_flip, gld_fwd_20)

uup_5 = where(is_flip, uup_fwd_5)
uup_10 = where(is_flip, uup_fwd_10)
uup_20 = where(is_flip, uup_fwd_20)

vix_5 = where(is_flip, vix_fwd_5)
vix_10 = where(is_flip, vix_fwd_10)
vix_20 = where(is_flip, vix_fwd_20)

# --- Correlation level at flip for event markers ---
corr_at_flip = where(is_flip, corr_60d)

# --- Hit rates (% positive) for summary table ---
# GLD 20d
gld_20_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(gld_20) and gld_20 > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(gld_20) else gld_20
# UUP 20d
uup_20_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(uup_20) and uup_20 > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(uup_20) else uup_20
# VIX 20d
vix_20_hit = 1.0 if (is_valid(vix_20) and vix_20 > 0) else 0.0 if is_valid(vix_20) else vix_20

# === OUTPUT 1: Rolling Correlation Context ===
# Question: "When did the SPY-TLT correlation flip positive?"
ts = index().value

xy_lines(
    title='When Does SPY-TLT Correlation Flip Positive?',
    category='Correlation Flip',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Corr (SPY vs TLT)', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    y_plot_bands=PlotBandSchema(bands=[
        PlotBand(from=-1.0, to=0.0, color=Color.Red, opacity=0.05, label='Negative')
    ]),
    order=1
)(x_values=ts, y_values=corr_60d)

# === OUTPUT 2: Grouped Bars — Median Forward Return by Asset × Horizon ===
# Question: "How do gold, dollar, and VIX respond after the flip?"
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Median Response After Correlation Flips Positive',
    category='Correlation Flip',
    y_axis_label='Median Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GLD', color=Color.Gold, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='UUP', color=Color.Blue, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='VIX', color=Color.Purple, stack='+5d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GLD', color=Color.Gold, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='UUP', color=Color.Blue, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='VIX', color=Color.Purple, stack='+10d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='GLD', color=Color.Gold, stack='+20d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='UUP', color=Color.Blue, stack='+20d'),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='VIX', color=Color.Purple, stack='+20d')
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Slate, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(gld_5, uup_5, vix_5, gld_10, uup_10, vix_10, gld_20, uup_20, vix_20))

# === OUTPUT 3: Summary Table — N, Median, Hit Rate per asset at 20d ===
# Question: "Can you trust the typical 20d outcome?"
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Correlation Flip',
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='20-Day Forward Stats After Correlation Flip',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['GLD', 'UUP (Dollar)', 'VIX'],
        col_headers=['Event Count', 'Median 20d Return', 'Hit Rate (% Positive)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Count, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(gld_20, gld_20, gld_20_hit, uup_20, uup_20, uup_20_hit, vix_20, vix_20, vix_20_hit)

# === EVENT MARKERS: Each correlation flip ===
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='SPY-TLT Correlation Flips Positive',
        icon=Icon.ShuffleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Correlation', dp=3, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='GLD +20d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='UUP +20d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX +20d', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(corr_at_flip, gld_20, uup_20, vix_20, is_flip)
